response.sql: WITH side_counts AS (SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) as order_count FROM riskandmargin r INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.dealedge), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_value FROM side_counts) SELECT SUM(sc.order_count) as total_sum, AVG(sc.order_count - ac.avg_value) as avg_excess FROM side_counts sc CROSS JOIN avg_count ac WHERE sc.order_count > ac.avg_value
